view.scene_description: The image depicts the interior of a large warehouse or storage facility. The space is filled with tall metal shelving units, each holding various items such as boxes and pallets. The floor appears to be made of concrete, and there are several yellow and black striped poles scattered throughout the area. The lighting in the room is dim, creating a somewhat dark atmosphere. In the background, there's a doorway leading to another part of the facility. A red forklift can be seen near the entrance, suggesting that this is an active workspace. The overall impression is one of organization and efficiency, typical of a well-run storage facility.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving units are arranged throughout the room, holding various items such as boxes and pallets. They appear sturdy and well-constructed, designed to hold heavy loads.

objects.label: boxes
objects.observation: There are numerous cardboard boxes stacked on the shelves, some with labels and barcodes visible. These boxes vary in size and shape, indicating they may contain different types of goods.

objects.label: pallets
objects.observation: Wooden pallets are stacked in several areas of the warehouse. Some are placed on the ground, while others are positioned against the walls or on top of other pallets.

objects.label: yellow and black striped poles
objects.observation: Several yellow and black striped poles are scattered throughout the room. These poles likely serve as safety markers or support structures within the warehouse.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor of the warehouse is made of concrete, providing a durable surface for heavy machinery and equipment to operate on.

objects.label: red forklift
objects.observation: A red forklift is visible near the entrance of the warehouse. It appears to be parked and not currently in use.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: In the background, there's a doorway leading to another part of the facility. It provides access to additional storage spaces or work areas.

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s2-34748", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
